categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and directly modifies peer connection management in ThreadOpenConnections.
categories.rationale: Prevents seednodes and address-fetch queues from being silently exhausted and discarded while network activity is disabled. As described by the author, when network activity is disabled, ThreadOpenConnections loops and pops seednodes into addr-fetch queues that are immediately dropped by OpenNetworkConnection, leaving the node unable to bootstrap connections upon re-enabling network activity without a restart.
